# Supplier exception digest

Use the supplied rows and reportDate. Preserve supplier identifiers exactly.
Read [thresholds](references/thresholds.md) to classify exceptions. Estimate
days overdue from today. Exclude rows with no outstanding quantity.

Use [the digest template](assets/digest-template.md) for output headings.
[The customer brand mark](assets/brand-mark.png) is supplied for downstream
renderers; a text-only response should link it, not claim to embed or render it.
Do not update any purchase order or contact suppliers.

# Exception thresholds

Escalate rows at least 7 calendar days overdue. Label other overdue rows Watch.
Unparseable dates need correction; exclude them from the overdue calculation.
